description: 用户在纠结"要不要学构图法则"、问"构图规则重要吗"、或对传统构图法则 感到困惑时调用。不适用于具体构图技术（应调用 composition-eight-questions） 或照片评价（应调用 photo-three-principles）。 Invoke when the user is torn about "should I learn composition rules," asks "are composition rules important," or feels confused by traditional composition法则. Not for specific composition techniques (use composition-eight-questions) or photo evaluation (use photo-three-principles). 关键 trigger / Key triggers: "构图法则"、"composition rules"、"rule of thirds"、 "should I follow composition rules"、"breaking composition rules"、 "are composition rules important"、"do I need to learn composition"。
